overview_description.description:
Almentor is an online learning platform that provides video-based courses and educational programs in Arabic and English. The platform covers subjects including business, technology, health, languages, and personal development. It serves individuals seeking professional skills training and self-improvement resources through digital learning.
The company operates in the e-learning and online education sector.
